title: Executive KPI Dashboard
description: High-level metrics and performance indicators consolidated into one clean view.
problem: The executive team was spending 10+ hours a week manually aggregating data from multiple platforms into static presentations.
solution: We developed an automated, real-time dashboard that integrates multiple data sources, presenting key metrics in an interactive and easily digestible format.

title: Cash Flow Management
description: Automated cash flow forecasting and tracking system for medium enterprises.
problem: Unpredictable cash flows were causing missed investment opportunities and frequent short-term borrowing.
solution: Built a robust cash flow model with predictive algorithms based on historical payables and receivables.

title: Inventory Control System
description: Comprehensive stock tracking with automated reorder alerts.
problem: Frequent stockouts and overstocking were eating into profit margins across 3 warehouses.
solution: Created a multi-location inventory tracker that automatically calculates reorder points and alerts purchasing managers.

title: HR Attendance Tracker
description: Manage employee shifts, calculate overtime, and track leave balances automatically.
problem: HR was manually calculating overtime and leave balances for 200+ employees, leading to payroll errors.
solution: Deployed a centralized attendance system that automatically cross-references timesheets with company leave policies.

title: Sales Performance Dashboard
description: Live leaderboard and quota tracking for distributed sales teams.
problem: Sales reps lacked visibility into their progress against quotas until the end of the month.
solution: Designed an engaging leaderboard dashboard that updates in real-time as deals are closed in the CRM.

title: School Grade Management
description: Automated grading rubric and report card generation for educational institutions.
problem: Teachers spent weeks at the end of each term manually calculating weighted grades and writing report cards.
solution: Built a comprehensive gradebook that automatically calculates term weights and generates printable PDF report cards.

title: CRM Lead Tracker
description: Lightweight, customizable pipeline tracker to close deals and manage client data.
problem: Small business couldn't afford expensive SaaS CRMs but was dropping leads using basic notepads.
solution: Created a lightweight, highly customized spreadsheet CRM with follow-up reminders and status tagging.

title: Google Sheets Automation
description: Custom Apps Script to connect APIs, send automated emails, and run background tasks.
problem: Manual data entry between an e-commerce storefront and the accounting software was causing massive delays.
solution: Developed a custom Apps Script that bridges the two systems, automatically syncing daily transactions.
